review_linkcode_resolve: review the linkcode_resolve function that generates GitHub source links for Sphinx autodoc
summarize_linkcode_resolve: summarize the linkcode_resolve function used by sphinx.ext.linkcode to resolve source URLs
refactor_linkcode_resolve: refactor the linkcode_resolve function to use a different git library or URL format
